svg.aria-label: An API gateway sits between clients and services. It terminates TLS, authenticates the request, applies rate limits, routes it to the right service and logs it.
svg.title: An API gateway sits between clients and services. It terminates TLS, authenticates the request, applies rate limits, routes it to the right service and logs it.
svg.text: One front door: cross-cutting rules live here, business logic does not.
